suggestions.title: Study for 25 minutes
suggestions.reason: School is on your list, and a short study block keeps the classwork from piling up.

suggestions.title: Review today's notes
suggestions.reason: A few minutes with the notes from today makes the next class easier.

suggestions.title: Start the next homework problem
suggestions.reason: Starting the next problem is the hard part, so this one stays small.

suggestions.title: Make 10 flashcards for the next exam
suggestions.reason: Ten cards is enough to feel ready without taking the whole evening.

suggestions.title: Read one textbook chapter
suggestions.reason: One chapter is a clear finish line when a textbook feels endless.

suggestions.title: Spend 20 minutes on a hobby
suggestions.reason: Something you actually like belongs on the list too.

suggestions.title: Put your phone in another room for 15 minutes
suggestions.reason: Fifteen quiet minutes gives your head a less crowded room.

suggestions.title: Listen to one song and do nothing else
suggestions.reason: One song, with nothing else going on, is enough to come up for air.

suggestions.title: Stretch for five minutes
suggestions.reason: Five minutes of stretching undoes a long sit.

suggestions.title: Take a 10 minute walk outside
suggestions.reason: When the list is heavy, a short walk is a real break.

suggestions.title: Pick a bedtime and start winding down
suggestions.reason: A bedtime you actually start makes the next day less of a scramble.

suggestions.title: Screens off 30 minutes before bed
suggestions.reason: Screens off before bed makes it easier to fall asleep.

suggestions.title: Set an alarm for the same wake time tomorrow
suggestions.reason: The same wake time does more for your energy than a perfect night.

suggestions.title: Write tomorrow's top three priorities
suggestions.reason: Three priorities beat a long list you will not finish.

suggestions.title: Finish one two-minute task you have been avoiding
suggestions.reason: A tiny task you have been avoiding is a quick win.

suggestions.title: Sketch a rough plan for the week
suggestions.reason: A rough week plan keeps the days from blurring together.

suggestions.title: Move a small amount into savings
suggestions.reason: A small transfer into savings counts, even if it is tiny.

suggestions.title: Skip one unplanned purchase today
suggestions.reason: Skipping one unplanned purchase is a real saving.

suggestions.title: Write down what you spent today
suggestions.reason: Writing down what you spent makes the money picture honest.

suggestions.title: Eat one piece of fruit
suggestions.reason: One piece of fruit is a simple way to look after yourself.

suggestions.title: Move your body for 15 minutes
suggestions.reason: Fifteen minutes of moving counts, even if it is not a workout.

suggestions.title: Reset your posture and unclench your shoulders
suggestions.reason: Unclench your shoulders. Your body has been holding the day.

suggestions.title: Drink a full glass of water
suggestions.reason: One full glass of water is an easy health win.

suggestions.title: Eat breakfast before you start the day
suggestions.reason: Eating before the day starts keeps the morning from running you.

suggestions.title: Sit down for a real lunch
suggestions.reason: A real lunch beats grazing over your work.

suggestions.title: Take three slow breaths
suggestions.reason: Three slow breaths reset a loud hour.

suggestions.title: Write one line about how today went
suggestions.reason: One line about today is enough to put it down.

suggestions.title: Start one load of laundry
suggestions.reason: Starting one load is the whole chore. Folding can wait.

suggestions.title: Tidy one surface for 10 minutes
suggestions.reason: Ten minutes on one surface is enough. Leave the rest.

suggestions.title: Plan one meal with someone this week
suggestions.reason: One shared meal gives the week a person, not just tasks.

suggestions.title: Send a message to a friend
suggestions.reason: A short message is enough to stay connected.

suggestions.title: Thank someone who helped you recently
suggestions.reason: Thanking someone makes the help feel seen.
